query GetUserIntents($user: String!, $status: IntentStatus, $limit: Int, $offset: Int) {
  userIntents(user: $user, status: $status, limit: $limit, offset: $offset) {
    id
    user
    createdTxHash
    createdBlock
    updatedBlock
    createdAt
    updatedAt
    ...IntentItem
    __typename
  }
}

fragment IntentItem on Intent {
  tokenFrom
  tokenTo
  amount
  priceThreshold
  status
  expiration
  __typename
}
